name: refund-before-payment
summary: charge.refunded arrives before the charge.succeeded it belongs to.
catches: Handler assumes event ordering — negative balances, orphaned refund rows.
diagnosis: Handler processed a refund before it had seen the charge.
manual_check_required: Inspect the database for a refund or negative balance on a charge/order that was never marked paid.
pass_detail: Endpoint rejected a refund for a charge it had never seen.
